# PANG, Zi Yang

> Final-year Computer Science student at HKUST (BEng Computer Science + Extended Major in Artificial Intelligence), ranked in the top 1% of undergraduates with a CGPA of 4.002/4.3. Full-Stack AI Engineer building agentic systems on Google Cloud Platform. Based in Hong Kong.

Over the past 3 years Zi Yang has completed 4 internships, most recently as a Full-Stack AI Engineer, and held leadership roles as Lead Webmaster of HKMSA and a Teaching Assistant for C++. Zi Yang currently works part-time as a Full-Stack AI Engineer at Zonic Tech, building an AI video editing system for large-scale video production, and is a Teaching Assistant for an AI course.

## Work Experience

- **Full-Stack AI Engineer Intern, Zonic Tech** (Hong Kong, June 2026 – Present): Migrated the AI agent from Vercel and video analysis from Azure into containerized Google Cloud Run services orchestrated via GCP Pub/Sub and Eventarc, consolidating a multi-cloud architecture onto GCP, eliminating serverless timeouts and reducing infrastructure cost. Built the company's video-editing AI agent on the Claude Agent SDK, with a skill library and custom tools for semantic search over analyzed footage in Upstash Vector and Redis. Cut agent invocation latency by ~75% by consolidating Next.js server actions and pipelining Upstash Redis operations. Scaled agent execution onto Cloud Run Jobs, extending max runtime by 45x for long-form footage.
- **AI Engineer Intern, Zonic Tech** (Hong Kong, June 2025 – Sep 2025): Built an AI-powered video editing system using OpenAI LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation with Upstash Vector and Redis, and LangChain agentic workflows. Improved PySceneDetect scene detection accuracy by 56%. Replaced Vercel's AI SDK RSC with a custom nested React context state system, making client-side updates ~60% faster.
- **Analyst Programmer Intern, Comptify Analytics** (Hong Kong, June 2024 – Aug 2024): Built a Python SMTP-based email verification tool that identified 60% of invalid addresses in a contact list. Engineered a full-stack director remuneration analytics platform (.NET, MySQL, jQuery, Bootstrap) serving over 1,000 multinational enterprise clients.
- **Frontend Developer Intern, Zonic Tech** (Hong Kong, Dec 2023 – Jan 2024): Rebuilt the website front end in React with Material UI and Storybook; participated in code reviews.

- **AI-powered News Reporter Agent**: LangChain agentic system that researches news, generates a consolidated PDF report, and emails it, turning 45–70 minutes of manual work into 8–13 seconds. Built with Tony Ding.

- **Supervised Fine-Tuning for Small Language Models** ([source](https://github.com/ziyang04/Supervised-Fine-Tuning-SFT-for-Language-Models)): Conversation-aware SFT of SmolLM2-135M. PyTorch.
- **Property Price Prediction Model** ([source](https://github.com/ziyang04/MLP_project)): Regression on the California Housing dataset. Scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow.
- **Image Classification Model** ([source](https://github.com/ziyang04/CNN)): CNN image classifier reaching 70.3% accuracy. PyTorch.
